title: Donald Trump controls Resorts International

tellings.quote: For a brief period, he was the guy basically in charge of it for a for a year or so.

plain: For about a year in the 1970s, Donald Trump was reportedly the person basically in charge of a company called Resorts International, which did business in the United States and the Bahamas. A researcher named Jason Simosa says this on the show without naming a source. He brings it up as part of a larger story linking a secret society to the UFO cover-up.
